title: Mouse Without Borders - New key button not working

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: Two user workarounds isolate module activation and legacy standalone installation as test variables.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Compare key generation across fresh activation and legacy MWB states.

judgment.rationale: New Key remains blank; recent users report this on 0.77/0.80.1. Toggling MWB from General and uninstalling legacy standalone MWB are separate workarounds, giving maintainers concrete comparison cases without confirming one root cause.
evidence: Original 0.70 WinGet report: New Key leaves the text field empty.
Earlier commenter says uninstalling the original standalone MWB enabled key generation.
Latest commenter reports v0.80.1 on two machines and says toggling MWB in General fixes it; the toggle on MWB settings page does not.
Live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-Mouse Without Borders, eight comments, unassigned.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with fresh module activation and with/without legacy MWB, then trace which state suppresses generation.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix exists; stale enablement state or legacy-install interference is plausible, but workarounds conflict and require controlled reproduction.

proposed_fixes.title: Make MWB key generation reliable after activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: New Key may execute before the current Mouse Without Borders activation/settings state is refreshed, or a legacy standalone install may interfere; the public workarounds do not identify which.
plan: On a clean current build compare New Key immediately, after toggling MWB in General, and after changing its page-level toggle.
Repeat in an isolated test environment with and without legacy standalone MWB installed.
Fix the confirmed initialization/conflict branch so the key is displayed or a clear actionable error is shown.
Cover first activation, enable/disable transitions and legacy conflict if confirmed.
verification: Verify New Key populates after fresh launch and after General toggle without reinstall workaround.
Compare clean and legacy-install environments without changing a user's daily-use setup.

confidence.rationale: Two different workarounds implicate activation state and legacy conflict, but no maintainer trace identifies the failing branch.

issue_context.summary: MWB's New Key button leaves the field blank; commenters report that toggling the module from General or uninstalling standalone legacy MWB can unblock it.
known_information: Original report: PowerToys 0.70 WinGet, not elevated; New Key did nothing.
One user says uninstalling original standalone MWB fixed generation.
Latest commenter: 0.80.1 on two machines; General-page off/on fixes it, while MWB-page toggle does not.
Live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-Mouse Without Borders, eight comments, unassigned.
inferences: Stale module state and legacy installation conflict are both plausible; different workarounds may represent different cases.
issue_context.analysis: The comments supply the useful comparison variables; a controlled maintainer test is more valuable than asking for generic logs.
initial_investigation: Reviewed full body and all eight comments through 2024-04-19T09:46:47Z, including latest v0.80.1 workaround.
No maintainer response, assignee, duplicate or fix link.
Product-Mouse Without Borders identifies ownership; no source-code cause asserted.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused MWB key-generation investigation; no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare New Key across activation and legacy-install states
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.80.1 if available
prerequisites: Windows test account with PowerToys settings
Isolated clean environment; optional separate environment with legacy standalone MWB
setup: Do not uninstall software from a user's daily-use machine; use an isolated test environment for legacy comparison.
steps: Open MWB settings and click New Key; record whether key appears.
Toggle MWB off/on from General, return to MWB and click New Key again.
Repeat in clean and, if available, isolated legacy-install environments; note whether the page toggle differs from General.
reproduce.expected_result: New Key reliably displays a generated key whenever MWB is enabled; any legacy conflict produces a clear explanation, not a silent no-op.
